# Code of Conduct

PySAD follows the [Python Software Foundation Code of Conduct](https://policies.python.org/python.org/code-of-conduct/). It applies to everyone in PySAD spaces: the GitHub repository, its issues, pull requests and discussions, and any event or channel that represents the project.

## Report a problem

Do not report a conduct problem in a public issue. Email the maintainer at the address listed on https://github.com/selimfirat, with "pysad conduct" in the subject line.

Include:

- links to the comments, issues or pull requests,
- what happened and when,
- the names of any other people who saw it.

The maintainer keeps every report confidential and replies within 7 days. If the report is about the maintainer, report it to GitHub with the "Report content" option on the comment or profile.

## Enforcement

The maintainer can warn a person, edit or delete their comments, close their issues and pull requests, or block them from the repository. The response depends on how serious the behavior is and whether it repeats.
